title: The Ugly Duckling
moral: Everyone grows in their own way and in their own time; being different is nothing to be ashamed of, and kindness to someone who feels different can help them find where they belong.
how_to: Every prompt in prompt_manifest.json is a template rendered from this file by production/image_prompts.py --story ugly_duckling_v1 (build, lint, show, md, review). Character identities are design specs until each canonical image is approved; then rewrite them from the image (hex sampled from it) and rebuild.

swans.name: the Swans
swans.status: design spec: rewrite from the approved canonical image
swans.identity: Each adult swan of the swan family is the same: one large, graceful wool-felt swan with a snow-white felt body (#F8F6F0), soft pearl-grey shading under the wings (#DCDAD3), a long elegant curved neck, a warm coral-orange beak (#E2784A) with a black knob and base (#1E1E1E), two charcoal-grey webbed feet (#4A4946), two kind round glossy eyes with dark-brown irises (#3E2A1E), black pupils, one white catch-light and ivory sclera, two large folded wings and one short pointed tail. With its neck up, each swan is a little taller than Ollie the swan. Fine looped felt fibres and small visible stitches. These intrinsic colours and this mid brightness stay identical in every image; scene light only tints and shades them. Their pose, facing and expression are the ones this prompt states.
swans.sheet: a large graceful snow-white felt swan with a long curved neck, a coral-orange beak with a black knob and two kind dark-brown eyes
swans.short: the Swans is a large graceful snow-white felt swan with a long curved neck, a coral-orange beak with a black knob and two kind dark-brown eyes.
swans.mouth: When a swan speaks, its beak opens slightly to show a soft pink inside.
checklist: coral-orange beak with a black knob

ollie_swan.name: Ollie the swan
ollie_swan.status: design spec: rewrite from the approved canonical image
ollie_swan.identity: Ollie the swan is one young, graceful wool-felt swan, Ollie grown up: a snow-white felt body (#F7F5EF) with soft pearl-grey shading under the wings (#DCDAD3), a long elegant curved neck and a small round head. His beak is warm coral-orange (#E2784A) with a black knob and black base (#1E1E1E), and his two webbed feet are charcoal-grey (#4A4946). Two round glossy eyes: dark-brown irises (#3E2A1E), black pupils, one white catch-light at upper right, ivory sclera (#F4EEE2), each framed by a small black patch between eye and beak; two soft pearl-grey brow stitches. Two large folded wings with layered feather stitches and one short pointed tail. With his neck up he is about twice Mama Duck's height. Fine looped felt fibres and small visible stitches. These intrinsic colours and this mid brightness stay identical in every image; scene light only tints and shades them. His pose, facing and expression are the ones this prompt states.
ollie_swan.sheet: one young graceful snow-white felt swan with a long curved neck, a coral-orange beak with a black knob, charcoal-grey feet and two dark-brown eyes
ollie_swan.short: Ollie the swan is one young graceful snow-white felt swan with a long curved neck, a coral-orange beak with a black knob, charcoal-grey feet and two dark-brown eyes.
ollie_swan.mouth: When Ollie the swan speaks, his beak opens slightly to show a soft pink inside; he has no teeth.
checklist: one swan, two large wings, two webbed feet
coral-orange beak with a black knob
two dark-brown eyes with small black patches

ottie.name: Ottie
ottie.status: design spec: rewrite from the approved canonical image
ottie.identity: Ottie is one cheerful, round-faced wool-felt river otter who can stand upright on her two hind feet and runs on four. Her fur felt is warm chocolate-brown (#6B4A32) with a creamy-beige face, throat and chest (#E2CBA8). Her round head has two tiny rounded ears, a broad muzzle with a big round dark-brown nose (#2E1E16), a smiling mouth line and four long pale whiskers (#EFE3CF) on each side. Two round glossy eyes: dark-brown irises (#3E2A1E), black pupils, one white catch-light at upper right, ivory sclera (#F4EEE2); two short dark-brown brows. Short arms with small webbed paws, two webbed hind feet and one long thick tapering tail. Standing upright she is a little taller than Mama Duck. Fine looped felt fibres and small visible stitches. These intrinsic colours and this mid brightness stay identical in every image; scene light only tints and shades them. Her pose, facing and expression are the ones this prompt states.
ottie.sheet: one cheerful chocolate-brown felt otter with a creamy-beige face and chest, a big dark-brown nose, long whiskers, two dark-brown eyes and a long thick tail
ottie.short: Ottie is one cheerful chocolate-brown felt otter with a creamy-beige face and chest, a big dark-brown nose, long whiskers, two dark-brown eyes and a long thick tail.
ottie.mouth: When Ottie's mouth opens, it is a rounded opening with a dark warm-brown interior, a soft pink tongue and small ivory teeth.
checklist: one otter, four legs, one long thick tail

mama.name: Mama Duck
mama.status: design spec: rewrite from the approved canonical image
mama.identity: Mama Duck is one plump, gentle wool-felt mother duck who stands on two webbed feet. Her body feathers are soft warm-brown felt (#9C6B43) with lighter speckles of buff-cream (#E3C9A0) and a pale cream chest (#EADBBE). Her head is the same warm-brown with a thin cream stripe above each eye. Her flat rounded beak is warm orange-yellow (#E8A33A) and her two webbed feet are the same orange-yellow. Two round glossy eyes: dark-brown irises (#3E2A1E), black pupils, one white catch-light at upper right, ivory sclera (#F4EEE2); two short soft dark-brown brow stitches. Two folded wings, each with a small teal-blue patch (#3E8A93) edged in white near its back edge, and one short pointed tail of feathers. Fine looped felt fibres and small visible stitches. These intrinsic colours and this mid brightness stay identical in every image; scene light only tints and shades them. Her pose, facing and expression are the ones this prompt states.
mama.sheet: one plump warm-brown felt mother duck with buff-cream speckles, a pale cream chest, an orange-yellow beak and feet, two dark-brown eyes and a teal-blue wing patch
mama.short: Mama Duck is one plump warm-brown felt mother duck with buff-cream speckles, a pale cream chest, an orange-yellow beak and feet, two dark-brown eyes and a teal-blue wing patch.
mama.mouth: When Mama Duck speaks, her flat beak opens slightly to show a soft pink inside; she has no teeth.
checklist: one duck, two wings, two webbed feet, one short tail

ollie.name: Ollie
ollie.status: design spec: rewrite from the approved canonical image
ollie.identity: Ollie is one young wool-felt cygnet, a baby swan who looks like a big, gangly duckling and stands on two big flat webbed feet. His fluffy down is soft dove-grey felt (#9A9893) with lighter pale-grey cheeks and chest (#C9C7C1); he is about half of Mama Duck's height, taller and longer-legged than the yellow ducklings, with a slightly longer neck. His beak is flat and slate-grey (#6C6B68) with a darker tip, and his two big webbed feet and long legs are charcoal-grey (#4A4946). Two large round glossy eyes: dark-brown irises (#3E2A1E), black pupils, one white catch-light at upper right, ivory sclera (#F4EEE2); two short soft grey brow stitches. Two small fluffy wings and a short fluffy tail. Fine looped felt fibres and small visible stitches. These intrinsic colours and this mid brightness stay identical in every image; scene light only tints and shades them. His pose, facing and expression are the ones this prompt states.

ollie.short: Ollie is one gangly young dove-grey felt cygnet with pale-grey cheeks, a slate-grey beak, big charcoal-grey webbed feet and two dark-brown eyes.
ollie.mouth: When Ollie speaks, his flat beak opens slightly to show a soft pink inside; he has no teeth.

ducklings.name: the Ducklings
ducklings.status: design spec: rewrite from the approved canonical image
ducklings.identity: Each of the three ducklings is the same: one small, round, fluffy wool-felt duckling who stands on two little webbed feet, with bright buttercup-yellow down (#F5D04A), a slightly paler lemon-yellow chest (#F8E27C), a small flat orange beak (#EE9A3A), two tiny orange webbed feet, two little stubby wings and two round glossy eyes with dark-brown irises (#3E2A1E), black pupils, one white catch-light and ivory sclera; two tiny brown brow stitches. Each duckling is about one third of Mama Duck's height. Fine looped felt fibres and small visible stitches. These intrinsic colours and this mid brightness stay identical in every image; scene light only tints and shades them. Their pose, facing and expression are the ones this prompt states.

blocks.style: Style: handcrafted wool-felt stop-motion storybook miniature; softly stuffed matte forms, tactile looped wool fibres, fine visible stitching and gentle handmade irregularities; warm child-friendly palette and soft directional light; clear subject silhouettes; faces and contact points sharply readable.
blocks.runtime_style: Handcrafted matte wool-felt stop-motion miniature, tactile fibres and stitching, softly lit, sharp readable subjects.
blocks.light_and_colour: Light and colour: every character keeps exactly the colours, saturation and brightness of its canonical image; the scene light may only tint it the same way it tints the background, with the same exposure and contrast as the background. Characters are lit from the same direction as the plate and cast soft contact shadows on its ground, so they sit in the scene rather than on top of it.
blocks.final_check: Before finishing, check: each named character appears exactly once and every group has exactly the number the cast line states; every bird has exactly two eyes, one beak, two wings and two webbed feet, Ottie has four limbs and one tail, and every character has two eyebrow stitches, one above each eye; no text, letters, labels or watermark anywhere.
blocks.edit_end_frame: This is an edit of the accepted start frame of this shot (the first attached reference): keep its camera, crop, background, light and every character's identity, colours, brightness, size and position exactly; change only what this frame shows below.
blocks.edit_reference: Edit the first attached reference, the approved parent image: keep the character's identity, colours, brightness and proportions exactly; change only the view or pose stated here.
blocks.edit_expression: Edit the first attached reference, the approved closed-mouth portrait: keep its crop, head size and position, every feature, colour, the felt texture, the whiskers, the backdrop and the light exactly; change only the brows, eyelids, gaze and mouth.
blocks.studio_full_body: Studio: plain warm off-white seamless backdrop, soft even neutral light and a small soft contact shadow under the feet; the whole body, ears, paws, mane where present and the single tail inside the frame with about 8% margin on every side.
blocks.studio_portrait: Studio: plain warm off-white seamless backdrop filling the frame edge to edge, with no room, furniture, floor or horizon, and soft even neutral light; head-and-shoulders crop with the whole head, both ears and any mane inside the frame with a small margin; the head keeps the size and eye-line of the approved closed-mouth portrait.
blocks.plate_rules: Empty plate: no characters and no story props. Normal-height camera, the whole scene edge to edge, open in-focus ground where characters will stand, distant background slightly soft. Every landmark keeps the position stated above; a different light state of this place reuses exactly the same geometry.
blocks.cast_scale: Relative size (fixed for the whole story, the same at the same distance from the camera), with Mama Duck's height as 1: each yellow duckling 0.35, Ollie the grey cygnet 0.55, Ottie standing upright 1.1, Ollie the grown swan with his neck up 1.9, each adult swan 2.1. The cygnet Ollie is clearly bigger than the yellow ducklings and clearly smaller than Mama Duck. Swimming, sitting or curling up changes a silhouette but never the size of a head, beak or wing.
blocks.studio_lineup: Studio: plain warm off-white seamless backdrop filling the frame edge to edge, soft even neutral light, one flat ground line at y=0.88 where every character stands, with a small soft contact shadow under each; every whole body, every ear tip, foot and tail inside the frame with a margin.

reference_roles.edit_base: the edit base ({what}): keep everything in it (camera, crop, background, light, every character's identity, colours, brightness, size and position) except what this prompt changes
reference_roles.identity_root: {who}'s approved canonical image: copy {who}'s identity exactly, with the same shapes, proportions, colours and brightness
reference_roles.locked_plate: the locked location plate ({what}): reproduce this background exactly, with the same landmarks, light and camera
reference_roles.world_state: the previous accepted frame ({what}): carry over the world state (props, damage, contacts and positions) unless this prompt changes it; use the framing stated in this prompt
reference_roles.camera_geometry: camera and layout reference ({what}): copy only the camera position and the layout of the place; take no character or prop state from it
reference_roles.expression: expression reference ({what}): copy only the brows, eyelids, gaze and mouth shape onto {who}'s canonical face
reference_roles.pose: pose reference ({what}): copy only {who}'s body pose and proportions, not the background
reference_roles.prop: prop reference ({what}): copy the prop's material, colour, shape and size; its state in this frame is the one stated in this prompt
reference_roles.mouth_design: mouth design reference ({what}): copy only the mouth opening, the teeth and their size
reference_roles.staging_only: older-version staging reference ({what}): copy only the composition, camera and staging; every character's look comes from the canonical images
reference_roles.size_anchor: size anchor ({what}): an approved frame of this same camera setup; every character keeps exactly the size it has there, and takes no pose, expression or prop state from it
reference_roles.framing: framing reference ({what}): copy only the shot size, where the head sits in the frame and how strongly the background is blurred; take no character, background, light or expression from it
reference_roles.size_lineup: the story's size lineup ({what}): copy only the size relation between Leo and Milo, applied at the sizes stated in this prompt; take no camera, background, pose, expression or prop state from it
